sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def tippos(frame):
    for i in range(64):
        for j,c in enumerate(frame.ascii.split('\n')[i]):
            if c=='r' and not (i in (30,31,32) and 51<=j<=53):
                return (i,j)
    return None
def do(action_list):
    return action(action_list)
# 2x S-right (up 6)
for k in range(2):
    res=do([{'action':'MOUSE','row':57,'col':28}])
    print('S-right',k+1,'tip',tippos(current_frame),'done',res.get('level_completed'),res.get('done'))
    if res.get('level_completed') or res.get('done'): break
# 11x O-right (right 33)
for k in range(11):
    res=do([{'action':'MOUSE','row':57,'col':13}])
    t=tippos(current_frame)
    print('O-right',k+1,'tip',t,'done',res.get('level_completed'),res.get('done'))
    if res.get('level_completed') or res.get('done') or res.get('game_over'): break
    if not res.get('board_changed'):
        print('BLOCKED at',t); break
print('final tip',tippos(current_frame),'level',current_frame.level)
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
